description: Six small oscilloscope rows, each drawing the voltage patched into it and passing that same voltage out beside it

params.text: Sets the length of the window every row draws; the knob is cubed, so most of its travel covers the short windows
Toggles capture between starting each sweep on a rise through 0V and drawing without that, the lamp beside it lit while the rise is required
Multiplies the drawn window, Default giving a window of up to 1 second and Slow up to 10 seconds
Clears every row's trace and starts the capture again

inputs.text: The voltage drawn on that row and passed to the output beside it; with nothing patched, the row takes the next channel of the nearest polyphonic cable above it

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of the row beside it, clamped to -10 to 10V, and 0V while that row has no signal

notes: a polyphonic cable in one input fills the rows below it as well, one channel per row, for as long as those rows have no cable of their own
